verified_fact: Nataraja (Lord of Dance) is Shiva's cosmic dance form. The Tandava represents the five cosmic activities: creation, preservation, destruction, illusion, and liberation. Each element of the Nataraja icon has deep symbolic meaning.
voiceover_script: Jab Mahadev nachhte hain — poori srishti kaanpti hai! Nataraja — Shiva ka cosmic dance form — sirf dance nahi, ye hai srishti ka pura cycle. Ek haath mein Damru — creation ki sound. Doosre mein Agni — destruction ki shakti. Pair ke neeche Apasmara — maaya ka nashaa. Ye dance hai creation, preservation, destruction, illusion aur liberation — panch activities ek saath!
debate_question: Nataraja ka sabse powerful symbol kya hai aapko lagta hai?
pinned_comment: 💃 Nataraja! Shiva ka ek dance poori srishti ka cycle hai. Om Namah Shivaya!
